evidence.note: Schofield places Hipparchus among works modern scholarship does not regard as authentic Plato.
Jażdżewska treats Hipparchus among the Thrasyllan dubia and as an outlier from genuine Platonic works.

rationale: Hipparchus is broadly regarded as non-Platonic despite Thrasyllan inclusion. Modern reference scholarship treats it as spurious/dubious, making C the appropriate classification.
